# Design sample with rich text for tests/e2e_format.js (DTS_FORMAT_FIXTURE=1)
@@ fmt-sample
title: Format sample design
category: Data & analytics
level: Senior
concepts: sql, duckdb, joins, kafka, spark
summary: A tiny design used by the browser test for rich text.
requirements: Functional requirements. Count clicks per campaign.
estimates: Average load. 5 billion events per day is about \( 5 \times 10^9 / 86400 \approx 58{,}000 \) per second.
design: The request path. Events go to Kafka, then to a table.
datamodel:
```json
{"campaign_id": "c-42", "clicks": 1200, "ok": true}
```
deepdive: Hot keys. Split them.
tradeoffs: Batch versus streaming. Choose batch when an hour of delay is fine. Choose streaming when the dashboard must be fresh within a minute.
failures: A broker fails. Its replica takes over in a few seconds.
followups: How do you dedupe? || With MERGE INTO on the event ID.
ref: docs | Sample | Nobody, 2026 |
